items.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: I played a boat ride in Charleston, South Carolina with the Metronome All-Stars... LeRoy Chisholm... had the Metronome All-Stars

ctx.x: Was there a gig in particular, when you were young, that really set you on your path, that maybe you said wow, I can do this for a living?

Um hum. The Metronome All-Stars in Charleston, South Carolina. There was a group of musicians that was led by a school teacher who played upright bass. His name was LeRoy Chisholm. I didn’t know he was a principal. I didn’t know anything about anything. I was just a humble kid hoping to get from one day to the next. But I found a LeRoy, a principal, a school principal. And he had the Metronome All-Stars that had a lady in the band, at the black YMCA. Everything was black and white back then by the way.…
